integrity: The analytic arguments prove the all-length statements; finite exact/numerical incidence-matrix tests corroborate but do not substitute for the proof. Claim to historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Real unit-edge-weight least-squares gradient and circulation projections on simple two-pole, internally disjoint path networks only; nonunit graph weighting and general series-parallel graphs are not covered. Older equivalent transfer-current or inverse-incidence norm calculations may exist.
title: Sharp endpoint stability of Hodge projections on generalized theta networks
